pd_new_teacher_mentoring_001.evidence: Support services for new teachers not participating in the PAR Program shall be provided through the BTSA, Intern, Pre-Intern, Para-To-Teacher, or other programs, as appropriate, with the goal of having every new teacher engaged in a support program.

pd_teacher_leadership_002.evidence: There shall be at least one (1) Lead Coach. In addition to the Peer Coach’s responsibilities, a Lead Coach shall have additional responsibilities which shall include, but not be limited to, scheduling the work of the Peer Coaches and facilitating the work of the PAR Panel.

pd_career_ladder_003.evidence: The parties do not see participation in the Program as part of a career ladder to becoming a District administrator.
